attchmntText: Audio recording of Earnings Conference Call held on November 13, 2026, on the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited has filed an audio recording of its earnings conference call with the stock exchanges. The call was held on November 13, 2026. It discussed unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the company website. The filing is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The document was signed by Amrit Pratik Acharya, Chairman, Managing Director, and Chief Executive Officer. His DIN is 0813243243. The scrip code is 545000 on BSE. The scrip symbol is ZETWERK on NSE.

attchmntText: The appointment of Mr. Dhanraj Dagar as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer  w.e.f. November 14, 2026, in place of Ms. Mania Sarkar, who will cease to hold the said position w.e.f. the close of business hours on November 13, 2026, consequent to taking up a different role within the Company.

The company reported a loss of 1,531.70 million for the quarter and 9,045.00 million for the six-month period. attchmntText: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited filed an investor presentation regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations grew 33% year-on-year in the first half of FY27. Gross profit increased 42% year-on-year, expanding gross margins to 13.6%. Adjusted EBITDA rose 69% year-on-year to 274 crore rupees. Operating cash flow improved by 46% year-on-year. The manufacturing segment revenue grew 20% year-on-year to 4448 crore rupees. Order backlog reached 14595 crore rupees, a 67% year-on-year increase. Repeat customers contributed 83% of first-half revenue. The disclosure is hosted on the company website.

attchmntText: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Zetwerk H1 FY27 revenue grows 33% to Rs 8,717 cr; Adjusted EBITDA grows 69% to Rs 274 cr".
voiceSummary: Zetwerk Manufacturing Businesses Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. H1 FY27 revenue grew 33% year over year to Rs 8,717 cr. Adjusted EBITDA increased 69% to Rs 274 cr. Gross margin improved to 13.6%. New orders totaled Rs 7,760 cr in H1 FY27, up 48% year over year. The manufacturing order book reached Rs 14,595 cr, up 67% year over year. In Q2 FY27, revenue grew 12% quarter over quarter to Rs 4,599 cr. Adjusted EBITDA rose 66% quarter over quarter to Rs 171 cr. Adjusted profit before tax turned positive at Rs 28 cr. Net loss decreased to Rs 88 cr from Rs 733 cr in Q1 FY27. The disclosure is hosted on the company website.
